sampleCards.title: Feather Tease
sampleCards.text: Use a soft feather or scarf to lightly trace over your partner’s body for 5 minutes. No hands allowed.

sampleCards.title: Blindfold Feed
sampleCards.text: Blindfold your partner and feed them something sweet or savory while describing how good they look.

sampleCards.title: Position Remix
sampleCards.text: Start in your usual favorite position, then switch to a completely different one halfway through.

sampleCards.title: Temperature Play
sampleCards.text: Alternate between something warm and something cool on your partner’s skin.

sampleCards.title: Dice Control
sampleCards.text: Roll the die. The number is how many minutes one partner is in complete control.

sampleCards.title: Guided Hands
sampleCards.text: The receiving partner places their hands over the giving partner’s and shows exactly the pressure and speed they want.

sampleCards.title: Dealer’s Choice
sampleCards.text: The roller picks any card from the entire deck and you both do it.

rarities.name: Common
rarities.body: The backbone of the deck. Reliable, repeatable, always welcome.

rarities.name: Uncommon
rarities.body: Metallic silver frame. A little more specific, a little more of an occasion.

rarities.name: Rare
rarities.body: Full holographic foil. The cards worth building a night around.
